mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.nickname, u.created_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM block b WHERE b.uploader_id = u.id AND b.status = 'APPROVED' AND b.is_active = true AND b.is_listed = true) AS block_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ub.user_id) FROM user_block ub JOIN block b ON b.id = ub.block_id WHERE b.uploader_id = u.id AND b.status = 'APPROVED' AND b.is_active = true AND ub.user_id <> u.id) AS collector_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(b.play_count), 0) FROM block b WHERE b.uploader_id = u.id AND b.status = 'APPROVED' AND b.is_active = true) AS play_count FROM users u WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.is_active = true

SELECT COALESCE(p.name, c.name) AS name FROM block b JOIN sound_category c ON c.id = b.category_id LEFT JOIN sound_category p ON p.id = c.parent_id WHERE b.uploader_id = #{userId} AND b.status = 'APPROVED' AND b.is_active = true AND b.is_listed = true GROUP BY COALESCE(p.name, c.name) ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MIN(b.created_at) LIMIT 3
